programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: RiffTrax: Fungicide
programme.desc: Putting the fun back in -gicide, it's Fungicide! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programme.title: RiffTrax: Bloody Pit of Horror
programme.desc: Filmed in PSYCHOVISION, (which we hear Fellini used to shoot in), Bloody Pit of Horror is must see Italian horror at its cheesiest. Mike, Kevin and Bill brave the spider piñata and give it their bloody best.

programme.title: RiffTrax Live: Star Raiders
programme.desc: In 2762, the galaxy is plagued with wars using hokey special effects. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Killers From Space
programme.desc: When an atomic bomb test triggers the arrival of invaders from another planet, some hack director combined the dumbest plots of a dozen b-movies into a single film! This feature contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax: When A Stranger Calls Back
programme.desc: The sequel is coming from inside the house! That's right, one of the oldest pop culture tropes finally gets a sequel! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax Presents: Sherlock Holmes and the Deadly Necklace
programme.desc: Sir Christopher Lee stars as Sherlock Holmes in a very German movie concerning the theft of Cleopatra's Necklace. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Bridget Nelson and Matthew J Elliott.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Psychotronic Man
programme.desc: A surreal journey into the trippy world of, uh, being a barber, it's Psychotronic Man!What does “psychotronic” mean, exactly?

programme.title: RiffTrax Shorts: A Christmas Carol (Coronet)
programme.desc: Since every entertainment franchise that has ever existed has put out their own version of A Christmas Carol, it's only fitting that the maniacs at Coronet Films decided to make their own. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Icebreaker
programme.desc: RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy action classic! It's Die Hard on Skis starring the legendary Bruce Campbell!

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon viaja a la montaña para esparcir las cenizas de su padre, pero presencia el asesinato de un traficante a manos de una policía corrupta. programme.title: Abanderados
programme.desc: Un documental sobre leyendas olímpicas

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas
programme.desc: Recién enviudado, un hombre ve alterada la tranquilidad de su aislada casa de campo cuando un policía irrumpe persiguiendo a dos criminales. La llegada del resto de la banda y del compañero del agente desencadena un enfrentamiento mortal en el que todos luchan por sobrevivir.

programme.title: El Último Guerrero
programme.desc: Son tiempos en que una civilización está reemplazando a otra. Está por comenzar una nueva era en Eurasia Central. Los escitas, los orgullosos guerreros, ya se han ido.

programme.title: El almirante: Mar de fuego
programme.desc: Basada en la legendaria Batalla de Myeongnyang. En 1597, durante la invasión japonesa de Corea, el almirante Yi Sun-Shin se enfrenta con solo 12 barcos y una tripulación inexperta a una flota japonesa de más de 300 navíos. Tras la destrucción del Barco Tortuga, última esperanza de Joseon, deberá usar su ingenio y valentía para cambiar el curso de la guerra.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon viaja a la montaña para esparcir las cenizas de su padre, pero presencia el asesinato de un traficante a manos de una policía corrupta. programme.title: El Lago de Amargas Aguas
programme.desc: Miriam regresa al pueblo en el que creció para grabar un podcast de terror junto a su exnovio, Adri. La afición que les unió de adolescentes será la clave para desvelar una aterradora verdad.

programme.title: Sobreviviendo en Marte
programme.desc: Tras un desastre ecológico, una familia sobrevive en un Marte desolado. Cuando unos bandidos atacan su hogar y matan al padre, solo Ilsa y su hija Remmy logran sobrevivir. Uno de los asaltantes exige quedarse con ellas durante treinta días para demostrar su valía. Madre e hija deberán decidir si pueden confiar en él mientras luchan por sobrevivir en un entorno hostil.

programme.title: Historia de una traición
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, Mildred Gillars, conocida como “Axis Sally”, es obligada por los nazis a emitir propaganda para soldados estadounidenses durante la II Guerra Mundial. programme.desc: Mark Peterson's journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa continues as he transitions from daytime stalks to the stealth of the night. In this episode, the focus shifts to one of the most elusive members of the "Tiny Ten"—the Cape Grysbok. Primarily nocturnal, the Cape Grysbok is a master of blending into the thick brush making it very difficult to get a good shot off. Hunting these ghosts requires a different set of skills and equipment, often involving spotlighting from the back of a Land Cruiser to catch the reflection of their eyes in the dark. Watch as Mark and the crew navigate the rugged Eastern Cape terrain under the stars, utilizing spotlights to locate their target.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: After years away, we finally made it back to North Dakota — the place where our hunting journey began. This trip was packed with memories and excitement as we enjoy the vastness of North Dakota. We managed to arrow a beautiful velvet buck, enjoyed a great dove hunt, and even capped it off with some walleye fishing.
